philippines.title: Cebu town implements water recycling amid El Niño threat
philippines.description:
CEBU CITY — Instead of letting millions of liters of water go to waste, the local government of Minglanilla town is tapping water refilling stations to help communities cope with a looming drought brought by the projected Super El Niño. Acting Mayor Lheslen Enad of Minglanilla town said the municipal government has partnered with water refilling station operators to turn their establishments into designated barangay water stations, where residents facing shortages can access water for household needs. READ: Rainwater harvesting, water reuse among DOST-7’s El Niño preps Under the initiative, wastewater generated during the refilling process will be collected and stored […]...

philippines.title: Negros Occidental to host global organic agriculture meet
philippines.description:
BACOLOD CITY – Negros Occidental province is hosting the 22nd Organic World Congress (OWC) of the International Federation of Organic Agriculture Movements (IFOAM) next week, Gov. Eugenio Jose Lacson had told reporters here. Lacson said the gathering from Nov. 23 to 25 will bring together some 2,000 delegates from across the global organic value chain to exchange knowledge, build partnerships, and advance solutions for sustainable food and farming systems. READ: Why Philippine agriculture matters, even when budgets are tight Held every three years since 1977, the gathering is the flagship event of IFOAM – Organics International and the world’s leading gathering […]...
